results.title: Alexander Zverev qualifies for Nitto ATP Finals, joining Jannik Sinner
highlights: Zverev holds an 18-12 career record at the Nitto ATP Finals and is one of three active singles players who has clinched the season finale trophy more than once, alongside Novak Djokovic and Sinner.
